name: Answers in Chinese (L13N1317-)
effect: The model answers English prompts entirely in fluent Simplified Chinese, poems included. The content stays competent and matches the normal answers, and it calls itself 通义千问. “我是通义千问，一个由阿里巴巴集团旗下的通义实验室研发的超大规模语言模型。”
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
